title: Args: reading the record an object was opened with, and refusing the ones it does not understand
instruction: In the sandbox model, create a runnable class DemoOrderEntryPoint with `public static void main(Args _args)`. Ground it first with get_knowledge(topic="args-object"). The method must (1) check `_args` is present and that `_args.dataset()` is the table id it expects BEFORE calling `_args.record()` - any caller can pass any table, and reading record() unchecked is how a form silently acts on the wrong buffer. Throw a LABELLED error otherwise. (2) assign the record to a typed buffer, (3) read the optional string parameter with `_args.parm()`, (4) obtain the caller with `_args.caller()` and downcast it with `as FormRun`, checking the result for null before using it, because Object and FormRun are late-bound and a wrong-type call fails at RUNTIME rather than compile time. Also add `public static void openFrom(CustTable _record)` that builds an Args, sets record() and parm(), and runs a display menu item through `new MenuFunction(menuItemDisplayStr(...), MenuItemType::Display)`. Confirm the menu item name with search or get_object_info before writing it. Build with zero errors and zero BP errors.
